name: Custom filters
descr: The filters an operator picks in the window that asks the server for data: a filter is a query of the developer answering the ids of its place - the goods, the orders or the customers. A parameter written as :NAME in that query is asked for when the filter is used; :NAME@ALIAS is picked from a value list instead of typed, and those lists are the second table here - their own queries run against the local base of the program and answer ID and NAME.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads the filters of every place and the value lists their parameters pick from - both tables whole.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a filter at the end of the list of its place. The query is the developer's own and is kept as it comes.

params.name: place
params.descr: the window the filter is offered in: 0 the goods, 1 the orders, 2 the customers

params.name: name
params.descr: the name the operator picks the filter by

params.name: sql_txt
params.descr: the query, against the base of the server, answering the ids of that place; :NAME in it becomes a parameter the operator is asked for, and :NAME@ALIAS is picked from a value list

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its own place; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of filters, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the filter, or several of them

params.name: place
params.descr: the window the filter is offered in: 0 the goods, 1 the orders, 2 the customers

params.name: name
params.descr: the name the operator picks the filter by

params.name: sql_txt
params.descr: the query, against the base of the server, answering the ids of that place; :NAME in it becomes a parameter the operator is asked for, and :NAME@ALIAS is picked from a value list

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list of its own place

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes filters by id. A profile of the window that asked for one keeps its name and finds nothing behind it.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the filter, or several of them

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the filters of one place in order.

params.name: place
params.descr: the window the filter is offered in: 0 the goods, 1 the orders, 2 the customers

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdParamAdd
commands.descr: Adds a value list at the end of the list. The alias is the name a filter parameter calls it by after the dog.

params.name: alias
params.descr: the code a parameter calls this list by, after the dog: :STOCK@QUERY_STOCK

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the list

params.name: sql_txt
params.descr: the query, against the local base of the program, answering two columns: ID and NAME

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdParamUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of value lists, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value list, or several of them

params.name: alias
params.descr: the code a parameter calls this list by, after the dog: :STOCK@QUERY_STOCK

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the list

params.name: sql_txt
params.descr: the query, against the local base of the program, answering two columns: ID and NAME

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdParamRemove
commands.descr: Deletes value lists by id. A parameter written as :NAME@ALIAS of one of them asks for a number by hand again.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the value list, or several of them

commands.name: CmdParamPos
commands.descr: Lays the value lists in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT
